import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
cal_col = header_row[header_row.astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'].index[0]
total_tax_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Total Taxes'].index[0]
result = int(df.iloc[total_tax_row, cal_col])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
sev_row = df[df.iloc[:, 1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'T53'].index[0]

# State columns: columns from Alabama (D, idx 3) to Wyoming (BB, idx 53), excluding DC
state_cols = [c for c in range(3, len(header_row)) if str(header_row[c]).strip() != 'DC']

sev_series = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[sev_row, state_cols], errors='coerce')
top3_cols = sev_series.nlargest(3).index
result = [str(header_row[c]) for c in top3_cols]

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
ny_col = header_row[header_row.astype(str).str.replace('\n', ' ').str.strip() == 'New York'].index[0]

ind_inc_row = df[df.iloc[:, 1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'T40'].index[0]
gen_sales_row = df[df.iloc[:, 1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'T09'].index[0]

ind_inc = float(df.iloc[ind_inc_row, ny_col])
gen_sales = float(df.iloc[gen_sales_row, ny_col])

result = 'yes' if ind_inc > gen_sales else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
hunt_row = df[df.iloc[:, 1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'T23'].index[0]

# All 50 states exclude US and DC
state_cols = [c for c in range(3, len(header_row)) if str(header_row[c]).strip() != 'DC']
hunt_values = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[hunt_row, state_cols], errors='coerce')
result = float(hunt_values.mean())
